toolDescription: Sports-tuned web retrieval returning cleaned article text from fantasy, beat-writer, and odds sources. Call this for injury designations, practice reports, snap counts, depth charts, inactives, betting lines, and player news — it surfaces primary sources that general web search buries, and returns extracted body text rather than snippets. Use the built-in web_search for general reporting and web_fetch when you need to read one specific page end to end.

query.description: Search query. Include player name, team, and week or date when relevant — e.g. 'Bijan Robinson ankle practice report Week 5'.

recency_days.description: Only return results published within this many days. Use 2-3 for injury and inactive news, 7 for trend pieces, 30 for season-long analysis.

leagueTools.name: get_league_context
leagueTools.description: Fetch the user's actual fantasy league from Sleeper: league name, scoring format, waiver type, roster slots, their current starters and bench with injury designations, their record and points, this week's matchup and opponent, and full standings. Call this FIRST on any question about the user's own team, lineup, matchup, or league — it replaces guessing about their roster. Takes no arguments; the server knows which league is connected.

leagueTools.name: get_waiver_activity
leagueTools.description: Recent completed waiver claims, FAAB bids, free-agent adds and trades in the user's league, plus league-wide trending adds/drops across all of Sleeper. Call this for waiver-wire advice, FAAB bid sizing, or to see what opponents just claimed. Optional `week` defaults to the current week.

week.description: NFL week number. Omit for the current week.
